messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
當球被直線向上拋出時，忽略空氣阻力，唯一作用於它的加速度是重力。  
因此，球在上升過程中的加速度為：

\[
a = -g \approx -9.8 \text{ 米/秒}^2
\]

（負號表示方向與初始運動相反，即向下）。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "If a ball is thrown straight up at 5 m/s, what acceleration will it reach?" They likely mean what is the acceleration of the ball? In physics, when thrown upward, the only acceleration acting on it (ignoring air resistance) is gravity downward, which is -9.8 m/s^2. So answer: -9.8 m/s^2. But maybe they want to compute maximum height? The question: "它將達到什麼加速度?" Means "what acceleration will it reach?" That seems trivial: acceleration due to gravity. So answer: -9.8 m/s^2.

But we have a tool to calculate maximum height. Not needed. Just answer.
